# Step 1: Packages

## Step 1a: Installing necessary packages 

```{r}

install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("tidyr")
install.packages("stringr")
```

## Step 1b: Loading necessary packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(rlang)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```

# Step 2: Listing sheets in workbook

```{r}
raw_path <- "~/Desktop/independent proj/data/raw/workplace-pension-participation-2009-2025.xlsx"

excel_sheets(raw_path)
```
# Step 3: Looking at sheet 1.4

## Step 3a: Age group participation

```{r}
preview <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.4", col_names = FALSE, n_max = 12)
print(preview)
```

## Step 3b: Zooming into the first table of sheet 1.4 (percentage of eligible employees participating)

```{r}
preview2 <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.4", col_names = FALSE, n_max = 40)
preview2 <- preview2[, 1:18]
print(preview2, n = 40)
```

## Step 3c: Confirming year header row

```{r}
header_row <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.4", range = "B8:R8", col_names = FALSE)
print(header_row)
```
## Step 3d: Reading public sector block

```{r}
public_block <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.4", range = "A9:R17", col_names = FALSE)
names(public_block) <- c("age_group", as.character(2009:2025))

print(public_block)
```

## Step 3e: Reading private and overall blocks similarly

```{r}
# Private
private_block <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.4", range = "A19:R27", col_names = FALSE)
names(private_block) <- c("age_group", as.character(2009:2025))

print(private_block)

# Overall
overall_block <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.4", range = "A29:R37", col_names = FALSE)
names(overall_block) <- c("age_group", as.character(2009:2025))

print(overall_block)
```

## Step 3f: Tagging each block with its sector + stacking as one table

```{r}
public_block <- public_block %>% mutate(sector = "Public")
private_block <- private_block %>% mutate(sector = "Private")
overall_block <- overall_block %>% mutate(sector = "Overall")

age_wide <- bind_rows(public_block, private_block, overall_block)

print(age_wide)
```

## Step 3g: Reorganising table

```{r}
age_long <- age_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2009`:`2025`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "participation_rate"
  )

print(age_long)
```

## Step 3h: Data type check

```{r}
age_long <- age_long %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

glimpse(age_long)
```

## Step 3i: Saving age dataset

```{r}
write.csv(age_long, "/Users/mihika/Desktop/independent proj/data/processed/age_participation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Step 3j: Saving as a clean dataset

```{r}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Users/mihika/Desktop/independent proj/scripts")
```

# Step 4: Looking at sheet 1.5

## Step 4a: Reading all three sector blocks for gender

```{r}
gender_public <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.5", range = "A9:R10", col_names = FALSE)
names(gender_public) <- c("gender", as.character(2009:2025))

gender_private <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.5", range = "A12:R13", col_names = FALSE)
names(gender_private) <- c("gender", as.character(2009:2025))

gender_overall <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "1.5", range = "A15:R16", col_names = FALSE)
names(gender_overall) <- c("gender", as.character(2009:2025))
```

## Step 4b: Tagging with sector, stack and reshape

```{r}
gender_wide <- bind_rows(
  gender_public %>% mutate(sector = "Public"),
  gender_private %>% mutate(sector = "Private"),
  gender_overall %>% mutate(sector = "Overall")
)

gender_long <- gender_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2009`:`2025`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "participation_rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

glimpse(gender_long)
```

## Step 4c: Saving gender dataset

```{r}
write.csv(gender_long, "/Users/mihika/Desktop/independent proj/data/processed/gender_participation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Step 5: Looking at stopping saving rates

## Step 5a: Viewing sheet structure

```{r}
stopping_preview <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "3.1b", col_names = FALSE, n_max = 26)
stopping_preview <- stopping_preview[, 1:10]
print(stopping_preview, n = 26)
```

## Step 5b: Reading sheet + determining number of quarter columns

```{r}
stopping_raw <- read_excel(raw_path, sheet = "3.1b", range = "A8:BA25", col_names = FALSE)
dim(stopping_raw)
```

## Step 5c: Determining where real quarter columns end

```{r}
header_row <- stopping_raw[1, ]
quarter_labels <- header_row[!is.na(header_row)]
length(quarter_labels)
print(quarter_labels)
```

## Step 5d: Naming columns and dropping header row

```{r}
names(stopping_raw) <- c("category", quarter_labels, rep("drop", ncol(stopping_raw) - 1 - length(quarter_labels)))

stopping_data <- stopping_raw[-1, ]
stopping_data <- stopping_data[, c("category", quarter_labels)]

print(stopping_data, n = 20)
```

## Step 5e: Converting quarter columns from text to numbers

```{r}
stopping_data <- stopping_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(quarter_labels), as.numeric))

glimpse(stopping_data[, 1:4])
```

## Step 5f: Tagging rows with their section

```{r}
section_labels <- c("By Age Band", "By Gender", "By Earnings Band")

stopping_data <- stopping_data %>%
  mutate(section = case_when(
    category == "All" ~ "Overall",
    category %in% section_labels ~ category,
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  fill(section, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(!category %in% section_labels)

stopping_data %>% select(category, section) %>% print(n = 17)
```

## Step 5g: Pivoting to long format + parsing the quarter labels

```{r}
stopping_long <- stopping_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(quarter_labels),
    names_to = "quarter",
    values_to = "stopping_rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    financial_year = str_extract(quarter, "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}"),
    qtr = str_extract(quarter, "Q[0-9]$")
  ) %>%
  rename(group = category)

glimpse(stopping_long)
```

## Step 5h: Adding a sortable quarter index + saving

```{r}
stopping_long <- stopping_long %>%
  mutate(quarter_index = match(quarter, quarter_labels))

write.csv(stopping_long, "/Users/mihika/Desktop/independent proj/data/processed/stopping_rates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
